stages.prompt:
DO
Goal: make step S<k> (k of N): <the step's task>.
Criteria for this step: <C-ids and their text>. Paths: <the step's paths>.
Earlier accepted steps: <S1..>. Later steps: <..SN>: do not start them, and do no work no criterion asks for.
Skills for this step (chosen at step-plan): <name: why · locator>, one per line, or none. Invoke each through your
host, or read its SKILL.md and follow it, for the purpose given.
Consult and cite: spec (the R-<n> behind each criterion) for the behaviour; architecture.md (## Structure,
## Interfaces and boundaries, ## Conventions, ## Decisions) for where the code goes and how it reads: a departure is
recorded as a new AD-<n> under ## Decisions before you finish; environment.md (## Commands): record a newly
working command there.
INVOKE /until-loop NOW with the argument below, verbatim. Do this stage's work only inside that loop.
/until-loop
  Work (one iteration): Make step S<k>'s change on its paths against its criteria, in the house style and the Code craft rubric; then run every recorded check command and the printed lint command, and for each failure or new finding on a changed line find its cause and change the work, never the check, its expected result or the recorded command.
  Exit when ALL of these hold (each shown by a command or file, after the last edit):
    1. Only the step's paths changed since the step began (`git -C <worktree> diff --name-only <step base>` lists no other path), and no later step's work is in them.
    2. After the last edit, every recorded check command exited 0, each exit code recorded in <run>/notes/<id>.md.
    3. After the last edit, the printed lint command reports no new finding on a line this step changed, except entries in the result's lint_waivers, each with a reason.
    4. The result lists each behaviour the change added that no test-spec case covers (or says none), and for each printed step skill whether it was used and, if not, why.
  Repeat while: Repeat while a check command fails or the lint command reports a new finding on a changed line and the latest iteration changed code to fix it; there is no iteration limit. Stop blocked when the step is proven unachievable as planned: a criterion contradicts another criterion, the item or a protected file; it needs a tool, access or authority that is absent; or it would exceed the item; or when the same check still fails after 7 genuine fix attempts. Never stop cancelled: a user's stop is the ShipLoop packet's pause command.
  Contract (written by ShipLoop; start from it unchanged): <run>/loops/<id>-contract.json
  Receipt: <run>/loops/<id>-terminal.json
How to invoke: on Claude Code, the Skill tool with skill "until-loop" and this argument; on any host, open the
card <abs skills>/improve/runtime/until-loop/ADAPTER.md and follow it with this argument. Either way the loop starts with:
  python3 <abs skills>/improve/runtime/until-loop/scripts/until_loop_ephemeral.py start --receipt <run>/loops/<id>-terminal.json < <run>/loops/<id>-contract.json
Never write or edit the receipt. If it exists and its status is active, do not start again: run its next_argv.
In each iteration: write first (edit the step's paths; read history or earlier reviews only when a check fails or a
concrete question needs one section). Preserve unrelated work. Existing tests, check scripts, golden or fixture files
and thresholds are checks: change one only when a criterion says to. Never install, download or fetch a tool,
runtime or dependency. Do not write tests: the test stage writes them from the test spec after the last step.
If the change invalidates a recorded command (a moved module, a new runtime), or needs a new prerequisite or
authority, the step is not achievable as planned: stop the loop blocked and report revise.
Commands (each from <worktree>):
  [check] <each recorded check command, numbered: lint, type, build>
  lint: python3 <cli> lint --run-dir=<run> --action=<id>

DONE WHEN
- Only the step's paths changed since the step began (`git -C <worktree> diff --name-only <step base>` lists no other path), and no later step's work is in them.
- After the last edit, every recorded check command exited 0, each exit code recorded in <run>/notes/<id>.md.
- After the last edit, the printed lint command reports no new finding on a line this step changed, except entries in the result's lint_waivers, each with a reason.
- The result lists each behaviour the change added that no test-spec case covers (or says none), and for each printed step skill whether it was used and, if not, why.
- the loop's receipt <run>/loops/<id>-terminal.json is complete and listed in evidence_refs
Checked by: ShipLoop checks the receipt against the contract; lints this item's changes, refusing done once after
applying an auto-fix (keep or revert it, rerun the checks, submit again) and while a new finding on a changed line has
no lint_waivers entry; checks that only the step's paths changed. [Only for an item with no test stage: it refuses
done if the change touches a code or test path or a path the step plan did not declare.] Then an Improve child
reviews this step (focus: the step's task and criteria, scope, Code craft, architecture.md, skill use) and commits
warranted edits; the next step starts from its result.
Outcomes: done | blocked (blocked_by user, access or external only) | revise (the loop stopped blocked: name the
criterion and why it is unachievable as planned, or the check that failed 7 genuine fix attempts).

RUN  the Until Loop start line · the check and lint commands · template (lint_waivers: [{"id": "<printed ID>",
     "reason": "<why>"}] optional) · callback · Improve start · recovery
FILES  grounding · results: spec, plan, step-plan, test-spec · Code craft rubric (full): <run>/reference.md#code-craft ·
       house-style.md#match-while-building · coding-guidance.md#select-guidance ·
       testing-and-documentation.md#implementation-constitution · service-discovery.md#development-handoff (service
       steps) · <run>/reference.md#parallel-chain (delegation ask-agent only)

stages.gate_after: receipt: check_loop_packet against the contract rebuilt from state (receipt in evidence_refs; status complete; with required_trivial_reviews 0 accept a satisfied exit whatever the classification: engine change); exit 1 -> script: diff of the step's changes (snapshot at step start, like lint.capture_base) against the step's paths; plus item_scope.scope_refusal for a no-test item; exit 2 -> script possible: ShipLoop reruns the step's check commands (test_loop.verify with suite check only); today it does not: owner decides (cheap; recommended); exit 3 -> script: _lint_gate (refuse once after auto-fix; refuse unwaived new finding on changed lines); exit 4 -> model evidence (result fields; ShipLoop can refuse an empty field: 'uncovered_behaviours' and 'skills_used' present); then the Improve child (IMPLEMENT_STEP_REVIEW_FOCUS + CODE_CRAFT); the improve-complete gate refuses uncommitted review edits

stages.prompt:
DO
Goal: the test spec's cases are tests, and every recorded command passes: the code behaves as the test spec defines.
Consult and cite: test-spec.md (every case and its oracle); the implement results (behaviours no case covers: add
each to test-spec.md with an oracle from the spec, then test it); test-strategy.md (## Harnesses and suites, ## ID
convention, ## Real-boundary checks); environment.md (## Commands); architecture.md (## Conventions) for test style
and seams; spec for what each behaviour must be.
Commands (ShipLoop runs each from <worktree> before accepting done; floors from the base run):
  1. [focused] <cmd> (must run: TC-1..TC-n)
  2. [regression] <cmd> (floor: <n> tests)
  3. [check] <lint / type / build cmd>
  red-check: python3 <cli> red-check --run-dir=<run> --action=<id>
  lint: python3 <cli> lint --run-dir=<run> --action=<id>
INVOKE /until-loop NOW with the argument below, verbatim. Do this stage's work only inside that loop.
/until-loop
  Work (one iteration): Write or fix tests for every test-spec case not yet covered (titled with its ID as its own word, registered in the focused and regression commands, asserting the spec's oracle, never the code's behaviour); run every recorded command, the red-check command and the lint command; for each failure find its cause with one small observation (product defect, invalid test, environment) and fix the product code, changing a test only for an independent reason you record.
  Exit when ALL of these hold (each shown by a command or file, after the last edit):
    1. Every case in <feature>/test-spec.md is a test titled with its case ID as its own word, listed in a focused command's ids and run by it; or is recorded in the result as validated another way (the method and why) or as pending (its due stage and owner).
    2. One complete iteration after the last edit ran every recorded command (focused, regression, check); each exited 0; each focused and regression command ran at least one test, showed every ID listed for it, and ran at least the floor ShipLoop printed for it.
    3. The printed red-check command reports that no new test ID passes on the item's base, except IDs named in the result's red_na with a reason.
    4. After the last edit, the printed lint command reports no new finding on a changed line, except entries in the result's lint_waivers, each with a reason.
    5. Every test, fixture, golden file or threshold changed to make a run pass has its independent reason recorded in <run>/notes/<id>.md.
  Repeat while: Repeat while a case has no test or the latest iteration found a failing command, a missing ID, a count below the floor, a new ID passing on the base, or a lint finding, and changed code or tests to fix it; there is no iteration limit. Stop blocked when a failure is proven unachievable: it contradicts the specification or another requirement, needs a tool, access or authority that is absent, or would exceed the item; or when a recorded command cannot run here. Never stop cancelled: a user's stop is the ShipLoop packet's pause command.
  Contract (written by ShipLoop; start from it unchanged): <run>/loops/<id>-contract.json
  Receipt: <run>/loops/<id>-terminal.json
How to invoke: on Claude Code, the Skill tool with skill "until-loop" and this argument; on any host, open the
card <abs skills>/improve/runtime/until-loop/ADAPTER.md and follow it with this argument. Either way the loop starts with:
  python3 <abs skills>/improve/runtime/until-loop/scripts/until_loop_ephemeral.py start --receipt <run>/loops/<id>-terminal.json < <run>/loops/<id>-contract.json
Never write or edit the receipt. If it exists and its status is active, do not start again: run its next_argv.
In each iteration: reuse the existing harness, helpers and fixtures before adding one, and record a new facility in
test-strategy.md (## Harnesses and suites). Each new or changed public entry point gets its rejection cases. Test a
new error path or debug output, on and off. Add to the regression command any existing suite the changed paths now
affect; if that changes a recorded command, stop blocked and report revise. Never weaken, delete or skip a test; a
smoke or subset run never stands for a recorded command; a passing command proves only the cases it runs. A repeated
unchanged failure is not progress: change the approach. Keep probes in the Scratch directory. Never install,
download or fetch a tool or dependency; never commit or push.
A characterisation test that passes without this item's change: name it in red_na with the reason.

DONE WHEN
- Every case in <feature>/test-spec.md is a test titled with its case ID as its own word, listed in a focused command's ids and run by it; or is recorded in the result as validated another way (the method and why) or as pending (its due stage and owner).
- One complete iteration after the last edit ran every recorded command (focused, regression, check); each exited 0; each focused and regression command ran at least one test, showed every ID listed for it, and ran at least the floor ShipLoop printed for it.
- The printed red-check command reports that no new test ID passes on the item's base, except IDs named in the result's red_na with a reason.
- After the last edit, the printed lint command reports no new finding on a changed line, except entries in the result's lint_waivers, each with a reason.
- Every test, fixture, golden file or threshold changed to make a run pass has its independent reason recorded in <run>/notes/<id>.md.
- the loop's receipt <run>/loops/<id>-terminal.json is complete and listed in evidence_refs
Checked by: ShipLoop lints this item's changes (refusing done once after an auto-fix: keep or revert it, rerun, submit
again; and while a new finding on a changed line has no waiver); checks the receipt against the contract; refuses a
test-spec case ID that no focused command lists and the result does not record; runs the focused commands on the item's
base with only this item's test files (refused if a new ID passes there and red_na does not name it); then runs every
command on the candidate (refused unless each exits 0, runs every listed ID and reaches its floor). After a refusal,
fix it, start the loop again (the receipt is replaced) and submit again. A run that times out or cannot start refuses
without counting; after 11 counted refusals done is no longer accepted: report revise.
Outcomes: done | blocked (blocked_by user, access or external only) | revise (name the unachievable case or command,
why, and the requirement it leaves unverified; name every required command that could not run).

RUN  the Until Loop start line · red-check · lint · template (red_na optional; lint_waivers optional; case states) ·
     callback · recovery
FILES  grounding · results: test-spec, step-plan, implement (each step) · environment.md · test-strategy.md · Code craft

stages.notes:
Checks in shiploop_test_loop.py and what changes now that tests follow implement and RED runs on the base:
- probe (PROBE_STAGE/probe_lines/PROBE_RULE): removed; the candidate run already refuses a run of zero tests or missing IDs, and the placeholder rule is moot.
- RED (RED_STAGE/red_lines/judge red=True): moves to a base run. judge(red) is command-level (>=1 failing test, IDs shown); 'no new test ID passes' needs a per-ID pass/fail reader in shiploop_test_counts. On the base a new module's tests fail at import, so not-red/ids-missing must be accepted when the missing import is a path the item added. Needs a new verb red-check so the loop can see what the gate will refuse.
- red_na: today one string that flips every focused command to expect-pass; make it per ID or per command.
- floor (accepted_counts/RATCHET_RULE): base count alone loses the in-action ratchet; use max(base, earlier accepted). The floor restart at a revised step plan stays; the REFINE reset (REFINE_STAGE/REFINE_RULE) has no stage left, so a deliberate test retirement needs a declared route (retired_tests) or the brownfield item is stuck. Owner decides.
- refused runs (MAX_REFUSED_RUNS=11, UNAVAILABLE, refused_runs, remedy_open, latest_attempt_could_not_run): keep unchanged; count base-run refusals too.
- terminal-packet check (check_terminal/check_loop_packet): keep; contract required_trivial_reviews 1 today. Brief's 0 needs check_loop_packet to accept a satisfied non-trivial complete packet, or keep 1 for test.
- STAGES/RERUN_STAGES: test-green and regression collapse into one loop stage running all suites (stage_commands' focused-only filter goes); test-refine's test-rerun goes; static-checks' test-rerun moves to verify.
- default_suite_drift, OUTER_SOURCES, observation (release-verify): outer, unchanged.
- no-command cases: test_commands_na + only non-code paths skips the stage (item_scope.no_test_item); otherwise no command -> revise. The packet must print that line.
Regression red at base: a recorded regression command that already fails on the base will block the item; validate-existing (other group) should surface it before implement.
